text: Do not beautify, de-age, slim or widen the face, enlarge eyes, smooth skin, correct natural asymmetry, reinterpret ethnicity or appearance, stylize the person, add makeup, introduce hard shadows, colour cast, HDR halo, rim glow, accessories, hats, glasses, jewellery, logos, props, source wardrobe, source background, text or watermark. Do not let any panel represent a different person.
